description: The fuel in the tanks at each point of the route and whether it is under the reserve: at the departure the fuel on board at engine start (full, the usable fuel, unless the pilot set their own; more than usable kept as set), the start, taxi and takeoff allowance and each leg's burn taken from them after; at each field landed at the fuel on landing, the tanks then fuelled for the next flight (full unless the pilot set what to; a figure under what is left keeps it, 0 no fuel bought) and its start and taxi taken again, as the planner checks each flight; negative past empty, the gallons short; null at a point past a leg whose burn is not known, until the next fill.

fuel_gal.description: The burn of the leg to it.

refuel.description: The tanks filled on landing there.

fill_gal.description: The pilot's own figure for the tanks as the airplane leaves there, gallons: at the departure the fuel on board at engine start, at a field landed at what it is fuelled to (under what is left keeps what is left; 0, no fuel bought); null, full.
